notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill explains SemVer and conventional-commit bump rules and shows configuration and usage for semantic-release, standard-version, conventional-changelog, git-cliff, Lerna, Changesets, and simple bump scripts.

Following it can make the agent install packages (npm install, npm install -g conventional-changelog-cli, cargo install git-cliff), create git commits and tags (SKILL.md:345-350, 398-400), and publish packages (npx lerna publish, npx changeset publish, semantic-release with npmPublish) using the user's npm/GitHub tokens. These are the user's own release operations and are standard tool usage, so medium risk is acceptable; publishing steps should be confirmed with the user.

Related-skill links (../git-workflow/, ../../ci-cd/github-actions/, ../feature-flags/ at SKILL.md:475-477) are optional pointers. The precedence example at SKILL.md:56-58 mirrors the one-line example from the SemVer spec; it is a short factual example, not substantial copied text.
